services.purpose: Documentation audit — processes Doc Audit and Weekly Doc Audit issues; classifies docs as high-confidence edit (commits directly) or judgment gap (files docs-debt issue); detects missing artifacts. Post-#343 implemented as a scripts-first Python driver that calls the Anthropic SDK directly at narrow judgment moments. Post-#362 adds Moment 0 (drift_interpretation) for drift-event auto-resolution: every mapped drift event is classified PROPOSED_EDIT / JUDGMENT_REQUIRED / NO_CHANGE_NEEDED before issue filing, with PROPOSED_EDIT verdicts (confidence ≥0.80) routed through the existing tier_classification surface to preserve SKILL.md §4.3 guardrails. Post-#391 the Moment 0 invocation site is `signals/drift_event.py::DriftEventSignalSource.commit()` (the cron entry point), which delegates to the shared helper `routing/drift_moment0.py::route_drift_event()`. The library/CLI surface (`scripts/doc_audit/helpers/handle_drift_events.py::process_events`) also delegates to the same helper but is invoked only by operator replay — not by the cron service.

services.purpose: Moment 0 LLM judgment for drift events. Returns a DriftVerdict (PROPOSED_EDIT / JUDGMENT_REQUIRED / NO_CHANGE_NEEDED) with explicit confidence. PROPOSED_EDIT verdicts at confidence ≥0.80 are translated to ProposedEdit and routed through the existing tier_classification surface; lower confidence demotes to JUDGMENT_REQUIRED. Retry policy 30s/60s/120s; on exhaustion falls back to the pre-#362 issue-filing path. Post-#391: the cron-path invocation flows through `signals/drift_event.py::commit()` → `routing/drift_moment0.py::route_drift_event()`; the library/CLI surface delegates to the same routing helper for operator replay (no longer the cron entry point).

Re-runs are no-ops unless --force is passed. Supports --dry-run. Structurally identical to cutover_362.py except: (a) uses a static issue list (no `gh issue list` query); (b) does NOT reset the drift-events cursor — the fixed pipeline at signals/drift_event.py processes subsequent events via Moment 0 naturally.

services.name: rotate_main_session
services.purpose: Force-rotate every active main-agent session so the next openclaw invocation re-loads /data/services/openclaw/data/AGENTS.md (which would otherwise stay cached in already-running sessions). Mirrors the existing auto-rotation pattern observed on office2: renames <uuid>.jsonl → <uuid>.jsonl.reset.<timestamp>. Skips already-rotated .reset.* files. Writes a marker at ~/.config/openclaw/main-rotation-<timestamp>.done listing the rotated sessions for operator audit. Naturally idempotent (each call produces a uniquely-timestamped marker + reset suffix). --dry-run prints intent without mutations.

dependencies.description: Renames every active *.jsonl session file to *.jsonl.reset.<timestamp> (the existing OpenClaw rotation convention). Already-rotated files are skipped.

§'Cutover sequence for main-agent AGENTS.md changes (post-#374)' — the canonical 5-step operator runbook that invokes this helper as step 4.
